title: Regular Polygons, Diagonals and Symmetry
introduction: Explore regular polygons, diagonals and symmetry using everyday examples.
definition: A regular polygon has equal sides and equal interior angles. A diagonal joins non-adjacent vertices. Identify regular polygons up to eight sides, their corners and lines of symmetry; use a protractor to measure angles.

examples.question: Identify a regular polygon with six sides.
